function.name: HashEditFile
function.description: Edit a file using hash-anchored line references (read first with ReadFile to get `line:hash` tags). All anchors are verified atomically before any write; stale hashes reject the whole batch. Supports replace (default), range replace (endLine+endHash), insertAfter (insertAfter=true), and delete (content=""). Edits must not overlap; insertAfter and endLine are mutually exclusive.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

edits.description: List of edit operations applied atomically in one batch.

line.description: 1-based line number of the anchor (must match the `line` from a ReadFile output)

hash.description: 2-char content hash of the anchor line (must match the `hash` from a ReadFile output)

content.description: New content for the line(s). Passing an empty string DELETES the line(s). Use \n for multi-line content.

endLine.description: For range edits only: 1-based END line (inclusive). Omit for a single-line edit.

endHash.description: For range edits only: 2-char hash of the end line.

insertAfter.description: If true, insert `content` AFTER the anchor line instead of replacing it.
